NBA DFS Picks for Tuesday, November 24 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Tuesday, November 24 · 3 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 24, 1:52 PM ET

Nikola Jokic (DEN) is the top-projected player on the Tuesday, November 24 DraftKings main slate at 63.4 DraftKings points for $11,700. Jayson Tatum (BOS, 50.3, $9,700) and Cade Cunningham (DET, 48.7, $9,400) are next.

Neemias Queta (BOS) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.65 projected points per $1,000 at $5,100.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 24, 1:52 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
